t: Gardener tender: Route work items to correct model based on lug model_fit field
description: The gardener currently spawns every per-spoke Claude session with the same model. Lugs now carry a model_fit field (HAIKU/SONNET/OPUS) indicating the cheapest model that can execute them. The tender should read model_fit from each work item's lug and pass --model to the Claude CLI accordingly. This enables self-directed cost efficiency: Opus defines work, Haiku/Sonnet executes it.
perceive: Read wheel-tender.sh lines 340-420 where per-spoke Claude sessions are spawned. Find the claude command invocation. Read how work items are passed to the per-spoke prompt. Check if --model flag is already supported in the Claude CLI invocation.
execute: Modify the per-spoke work loop: (1) For each work item claimed from the spoke's open/in_progress lugs, read the model_fit field. (2) Default to 'sonnet' if model_fit is absent. (3) Map model_fit values: HAIKU→'claude-haiku-4-5', SONNET→'claude-sonnet-4-6', OPUS→'claude-opus-4-6'. (4) Pass --model to the claude CLI invocation. (5) If multiple work items for one spoke have different model_fit values, group by model and run highest-capability model (a SONNET item + HAIKU item in same spoke → run SONNET for both). (6) Log model selection in the gardener pass record.
verify: Run wheel-tender.sh --all --dry-run. Verify: (a) log shows model selection per spoke, (b) HAIKU items get haiku model, (c) mixed items get highest model, (d) no regression in existing functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Per-spoke Claude sessions use model from lug model_fit field
Default to sonnet when model_fit absent
Mixed model_fit items within same spoke use highest capability model
Model selection logged in gardener pass record
Dry-run mode shows model routing without executing
